name: Simply Wood Studios Workshop
old_description: Welcome to Simply Wood Studios! Our gift galleries feature art and crafts made by Hawaiian Artist and Crafters. Our gifts are 100% created in Hawaii.
about:
Simply Wood Studios Workshop operates a gallery and workshop in Honolulu, Hawaii, at 1321 Hart Street, Suite 207. The business presents itself as a showcase for art and crafts created by Hawaiian artists and crafters, with all goods described as 100% made in Hawaii. No founding year, ownership structure, or founder names are disclosed in the available sources.

The company curates and retails a wide range of Hawaiian-made products, including pens, jewelry, bowls, boxes, glass art, sculpture, and accessories. Items feature materials such as koa wood, Italian acrylic, resin, glass, sterling silver, pearls, and aluminum. The operation includes a physical workshop and gallery open by appointment, but no manufacturing processes, facility size, headcount, or production volumes are provided.

The customer base appears to be retail consumers seeking Hawaiian gifts and art, with the stated mission of promoting the islands' cultural heritage and empowering local artisans. The gallery markets its collection globally through its website.

The business emphasizes its Hawaiian roots and the authenticity of its curated collection as its defining purpose, aiming to spread the aloha spirit worldwide.
